recap: Cavaliers beat the Nets 147–135 in 2 overtimes.
Collin Sexton led the Cavaliers with 42 points (16-29 FG, 5-11 3PT), 5 rebounds and 5 assists.
Kevin Durant led the Nets with 38 points (12-25 FG, 3-9 3PT), 12 rebounds and 8 assists.
CLE won 3 of 4 factors: shooting, ball security, second chances. Effective FG% 60.6 to 52.4.
Biggest swing: Collin Sexton offensive rebound (OT 46.8), +32 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): Nance, Osman, Prince, Allen, Sexton, +11 in 5:13.
Bench points: CLE 44, BKN 10. Points in the paint: 64–48. Second-chance points: 20–17.
